title: Excluded Causes Schedule for the Workmanship Warranties
content:
Each Workmanship Warranties plan lists causes that are never covered. A concern whose cause is on the plan's list is not covered under that plan, whatever its kind.

| Cause never covered | Chip Repair Guarantee | Calibration Workmanship Warranty | Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty | Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty | Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty | Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| New damage | listed | listed | listed | listed | listed | listed |
| Neglect | listed | not listed | listed | not listed | listed | listed |
| Environmental fallout | listed | not listed | listed | not listed | listed | listed |
| Rock chip | not listed | not listed | listed | listed | listed | listed |
| Wear item | not listed | not listed | not listed | not listed | listed | listed |
| Outside the repaired area | listed | listed | listed | listed | listed | listed |
| Altered by others | not listed | listed | listed | listed | listed | listed |

## Each plan's list

- **Chip Repair Guarantee:** new damage, neglect, environmental fallout, outside the repaired area.
- **Calibration Workmanship Warranty:** new damage, outside the repaired area, altered by others.
- **Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty:** new damage, rock chip, environmental fallout, neglect, outside the repaired area, altered by others.
- **Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty:** new damage, rock chip, outside the repaired area, altered by others.
- **Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty:** new damage, rock chip, environmental fallout, neglect, wear item, outside the repaired area, altered by others.
- **Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty:** new damage, rock chip, environmental fallout, neglect, wear item, outside the repaired area, altered by others.

Q. Is a rock chip an excluded cause under the Chip Repair Guarantee?
A. No. Rock chip is listed under the Cosmetic Repair Workmanship Warranty, the Glass Installation Lifetime Warranty, the Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty and the Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty; it is not listed under the Chip Repair Guarantee or the Calibration Workmanship Warranty.

Q. Which causes appear on every plan's list?
A. New damage and outside the repaired area.
